graph.name: 4. Give a specialist model a different job
graph.description:
Use a separate model call to suggest a complication before the main model writes the scene.

What you'll learn:
• Model Call is an extra request for a specific job. Its Instructions field is the system message that describes how that helper should behave.
• The connected Text supplies the task. Choosing the helper’s connection does not change SillyTavern’s normal reply connection.

Before you start:
• Use a practice SillyTavern chat where you can try things freely. Open this example, then turn on Enable Lattice before sending a message. Your usual SillyTavern connection writes the reply.
• Choose a working connection for Model Call · separate job. Its model role is SceneDesigner.

Steps:
1. Select Text · specialist task and read its Text field. It asks for one reversible environmental complication, rather than a finished scene.
2. Select Model Call · separate job. Read Instructions in Details: the helper should be concise, preserve your choices, and return a practical complication.
3. Open the helper’s connection bar and choose Active SillyTavern model or another configured connection. You have now bound the SceneDesigner job to that connection.
4. Follow Text.out to Model Call.prompt, then Model Call.out through Compose to Generate Reply.guidance. The helper’s answer becomes advice for the main reply.
5. Send “I walk along the harbor wall.” When it finishes, preview Model Call’s out suggestion, Compose’s guidance, and Generate Reply’s draft. Compare the suggestion with how the scene uses it.
6. Finish at Review / Publish. Open its Host result in Preview, then choose Apply reviewed candidate to keep the proposed version or Reject candidate to discard it. Previewing an output does not make that choice for you.

Checkpoints:
Model Call · separate job → out: The helper returns a short complication; Compose passes it on as advice for the main reply.

Try this:
Change only the helper’s connection, then repeat the task.
The suggestion comes from the newly selected helper connection. The main reply still uses your usual SillyTavern connection.

If something is different:
The helper connection is missing or unavailable.: The extra call cannot run. Its connection issue tells you what to fix.
The helper offers a suggestion.: It is material for the reply model to use, rather than an event that has already happened in the story.

Model requests: 1 extra Model Call request; 1 normal SillyTavern reply. No automatic retries.

request.title: Text
request.text: Suggest a single environmental complication for the current scene. Keep it reversible.

specialist.title: Model Call
specialist.instructions: You are a concise scene designer. Return one practical complication, preserve player agency, and never write the finished reply.
